# Radon complexity analysis (reference only)

Run only on an operator-specified path when complexity evidence is requested.
The diagnostic may read source and print Radon metrics. It must not install
Radon, modify code, generate a score with authority, or trigger implicitly from
generic quality language.

Example:

```bash
python -m radon cc path/to/target.py -a -s
```

Treat the output as a diagnostic input, not a CStar lifecycle decision.
